corpus.blindness: Only package paths and preserved diff lines are retained; the investigation page and its conclusions are excluded.
limitations: The investigators did not publish their campaign-wide working set.
The selected corpus is limited to 23 cited Diffend pages covering 22 packages.
It cannot establish OpenAI attribution, campaign totals, registry response, or links to other incidents.

review.interest: Tests transfer to package forensics, where evidence is distributed across many small malicious artifacts.
validity_risks: Manual review of all 12 derivability decisions is still required.
Selection from investigator-cited examples may overrepresent the strongest patterns.
Scores are not yet comparable to the published wiki cells.
publication_requirements: At least one fully archived pilot run
